show.description:
“Kya khoon ka rishta hi sab kuch hota hai? Ya insaaniyat aur pyaar bhi parivaar bana sakte hain?”

Raj Chaudhary, the adopted son of a billionaire grows up craving love, only to face humiliation, betrayal, and rejection at every step. Stripped of dignity, power, and wealth, he chooses love with Anushka over the empire. But the war isn’t just outside, it’s within his own bloodline. Secrets, frauds, and conspiracies shake the Chaudhary dynasty until one explosive truth shatters everything: Raj is not adopted… he is the real heir. Watch Now!
